accepted_source_pack.canonical_content_text: Working gas in storage was 3,567 Bcf as of Friday, October 9, 2026, according to EIA estimates. This represents a net increase of 67 Bcf from the previous week. Stocks were 143 Bcf less than last year at this time and 45 Bcf above the five-year average of 3,522 Bcf. At 3,567 Bcf, total working gas is within the five-year historical range.

This week is the final publication of the Natural Gas Weekly Update. On January 29, we are launching the Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report (WNGSR) Supplement on EIA's Beta site. This supplement will be published every Thursday afternoon. You can find information on our upcoming releases and how to contact us on our website.
